notes.note: Reviewed the new settings-page source relationship after merging main. This PR adds the independent default-off Open and Settled inbox preview row; the bounded-work, learning, compaction, supervision and usage preview descriptions and their authority/provider limits remain unchanged. Personal settlement grants no work-execution permission.

Reviewed the merged MessageBubble change: feedback now receives turn/session/Project identities from main. It does not change assistant answer-width ownership, account portability, user sizing or the shared mobile width override documented here. The merged context meter retains upstream compaction policy in its accessible label. Existing qualification limits remain.

Inspected the retained upstream PNG (learning in both themes and widths, or working-configuration/compaction/supervision/usage controls) and compared the assistant-only index.css delta. These non-transcript surfaces are outside chat-messages[data-answer-width] .message.assistant. The selector reuse changes no captured control, admission or provider effect. Capture bytes, revision and existing source/fixture/platform limits remain; no recapture or current native/provider qualification is claimed.
